name: hud_ui_mgr_sensor_set_viewport_rect
description: HudUiMgrSensor::SetViewportRect stores raw and scaled sensor viewport rectangles, builds the float source rectangle, computes clamp half-extents, and forwards the source rectangle to zClipAlt.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; the existing VC target remains available for a later coherent HUD sensor tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x410d10 validates storing raw x/y/right/bottom, branching on zOpt::GetReplicateMode, copying raw coordinates when replication is disabled, signed-halving x/y/width/height when replication is enabled, converting source bounds to floats, dividing source width and height by sensorParam for clamp half-extents, and calling zClipAlt::SetSourceRect.
The native smoke verifies disabled-replication and enabled-replication paths, raw and scaled rectangles, float source bounds, clamp half-extents, and zClipAlt source globals.
